text:
Nora: Heads up 1- putting together a tiny list of go-to eats for visiting folks. drop quick recs (price + group friendly + any late-night notes)
Raj: SF (SoMa) - Bar Crudo for seafood, mid-range, decent for 4-6 but can be loud. 20-35pp. two blocks from the office.
Priya: SF late-night - Ramen Izakaya on Folsom, cheapish, no-reservations, great when flights land late.
Ben: SF delivery trick - order from Off Hours or Munchery early if you need warm group lunch at the office. Avoid noon-12:30 pickup.
Nora: NYC recs? both quick and nice sit-downs please.
Raj: NYC - For quick: Lukes Lobster (fast, touristy but reliable). For sit-down: Cafe Mogador in East Village, relaxed vibe, good for small meetings.
Priya: NYC budget - grabbing bagels: Ess-a-Bagel or Best Bagel & Coffee, cheap and fast for large teams.
Ben: London/Berlin notes? any transit tips for guests?
Priya: London - Dishoom is great but book. For groups on a budget: Franco Manca (sourdough pizza) good for 6-10.
Raj: Berlin - Mustafas Kebab for a classic late-night bite, tiny spot, very cheap. For nicer dinner: Katz Orange (pre-book).
Nora: Any veg/halal-friendly flags we should add?
Ben: Add icons: VGN for vegan-friendly, HAL for halal options, GF for gluten-free. Example: Mustafas (HAL), Dishoom (VGN options), Bar Crudo (GF available).
Priya: Also add approx transit time from the office and nearest transit stop. helps when scheduling demos.
OpsBot: reminder: update the Team Eats doc in /handbook/travel with any new entries. Also ping ops if you need catering budget.
Nora: Love it - I'll assemble and keep it <1 page. if anyone has photos of the places or quick menu items to highlight, DM me.
Raj: I'll drop a photo of the ramen place and note they close at 11pm on weekdays.
Ben: Poll idea: where should we do the next team offsite dinner? drop one-word recs and I'll run a quick poll later.
